create_DonutImageProcessor: create a DonutImageProcessor instance with custom size, thumbnail, and alignment settings for document image preprocessing
run_preprocess_images: run the DonutImageProcessor preprocess method to resize, pad, rescale, and normalize a batch of images into pixel values
align_long_axis_image: align the long axis of a torch tensor image to match the target size dimensions by rotating 90 degrees when needed
thumbnail_image_to_size: resize an image to fit within target dimensions using thumbnail scaling that preserves aspect ratio
pad_image_to_dimensions: pad a torch tensor image with centered or random padding to reach the specified output dimensions
